      "reasoning":"The established device, matching card/IP geography, successful card verification and ordinary attempt activity support legitimate ordering. Earlier delivery disputes can reflect genuine delivery problems, though the rejected claim warrants context."

  "memo":"Recommend clear under FP-2 §6.6(c). R09 holds from two earlier item-not-received disputes, but it is Context only and cannot support adverse action. One rejected delivered-order claim does not establish item-not-received abuse; no other earlier outcome settles this order. No adverse-family rule holds. The address's three lifetime accounts do not satisfy R08, which uses recent activity; neither device nor address linkage requires a household exception. Established device use, matching geography and successful verification favor legitimate ordering over delivery-claim abuse. No verification check is required, and identity checks would not resolve delivery-claim intent. This recommendation is advisory and sets no queue priority."
